S50U26.today_summary: 1081.1 closed +8.2 (+0.76%), 11.1 points above the 1070 max pain that has now held for 12 consecutive sessions and 18.9 points below the 1100 gamma flip. Cumulative net GEX at spot is -2,492 baht/point - still amplifying - but a +3,413 improvement on yesterday's -5,905, and the 1080 strike itself now carries a +2,215 long-gamma shelf against -1,342 at 1050. what_changed: Cumulative net GEX at spot halved to -2,492 from -5,905 as the rally carried 1081.1 to within 18.9 points of the flip, which itself stepped down 1110 to 1100 - the short-gamma pocket is 50% closed in one session.

25-delta skew compressed to +0.45 from +1.57 (+0.52 holding yesterday's 1040/1100 strikes fixed) while ATM IV fell -0.74 to 12.97% on a rally - near-money protection cheapened as tail protection was bid.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Over five sessions (08-14 to 08-21) the future added +9.4 points to 1081.1 while max pain never left 1070 and ATM IV finished flat at 12.97% versus 12.97% - the move was absorbed by the option structure, not repriced by it. Put OI grew +6,917 (+22.6%) to 37,537 against +608 of calls (+3.4%), lifting P/C OI from 1.73 to 2.05, and +3,612 of that build went into the 910 strike that today turned 15 lots on 14,930 OI and now fails Vol2Vol outright. The call wall migrated 1080 to 1100 on 08-20 and held, while the gamma flip stepped 1110 to 1100, compressing the short-gamma pocket from 38.3 points to 18.9. Cumulative GEX at spot never turned positive across the window, ranging -5,905 to -1,999, so dealers have been in an amplifying posture for every recorded session of this series. 25-delta skew round-tripped +1.80 (08-13) to +0.12 (08-17) to +1.57 (08-20) to +0.45 today - the surface keeps re-pricing near-money protection while only the tail bid compounds.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1050 / 1020
strategies.rationale: Protection-zone insurance where the amplification actually lives: 1050 is the live near put wall (1,687 OI on 400 lots) and the chain's most negative strike at -1,342 net GEX, so a break there has dealers hedging with the move rather than against it, and 12.97% ATM IV at the low end of the 12.50-13.71 eight-session band makes the debit cheap.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, capped by the 30-point spread width; 1020 is the 10-delta put band.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close above 1100 - the call wall and gamma flip together - turns cumulative GEX positive and removes the downside amplification.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1100 / 1130
strategies.rationale: Upside convexity is the cheapest part of this surface with 25-delta skew at +0.45 (1110 call 13.44% vs 1050 put 13.89%), and the 1100 cap is less defended than its 2,471 OI suggests after shedding 89 OI on 469 lots today; above 1100 dealers turn long gamma and dampen, which is exactly the capped payoff a debit spread wants.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, capped by the 30-point spread width.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1050, where net GEX is -1,342 and dealer hedging turns pro-trend to the downside.

strategies.name: Reverse iron condor 1050 / 1020 put x 1100 / 1130 call
strategies.rationale: The direction-agnostic expression of the same read - dealers short gamma at spot (-2,492) with IV compressed to 12.97% and 1-sigma at 8.83 points is the matrix's short-gamma-plus-cheap-IV case, where a defined-risk long strangle beats picking a side while spot sits 11.1 points above max pain and 18.9 below the flip.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = total net debit paid for both wings; it expires worthless if the future finishes between 1050 and 1100.
strategies.invalidation: Realized range collapsing inside 1050-1100 with cumulative GEX at spot turning positive - the structure decays fastest exactly where the 1070 max-pain basin is shallowest.

S50U26.prediction: 1081.1 with cumulative GEX at spot at -2,492 and the 1100 flip 18.9 points overhead frames a two-sided market with an amplifying bias: the base case is travel inside 1050-1100 at roughly the 8.83-point daily 1-sigma, with 1070 max pain a weak magnet 11.1 points below. The break that matters is 1050 - the live near put wall at 1,687 OI and the chain's most negative strike at -1,342 net GEX - where dealer hedging turns pro-trend and the 1020 10-delta band opens. A daily close above 1100 flips cumulative gamma positive, converts dealers into dampeners and invalidates the amplification read outright.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice and not a recommendation to execute anything. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1070 max-pain anchor as a tendency, not a target, especially at 39 days to expiry where gamma is diffuse. Defined-risk is not risk-free - the capped max loss on every structure above is real and does occur. Macro and news flow can override the option structure entirely, and the 910 put wall's 14,930 OI is stale positioning that will not act as live support.
